en:
It feels like we were just given our <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=typeNORMAL>
talents on a whim...

And now we're in this lousy situation...
Being an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=typeNORMAL> sucks...

I don't know why I'm complaining to you.
You're stuck here, too.

...And if there's time to complain, I'd rather
spend it being productive.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time searching around the school
for clues with Maki...
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki and I grew a little closer today.
